hooks.command: r=$(pwd); while [ "$r" != / ] && [ ! -e "$r/.sb" ] && [ ! -e "$r/.git" ]; do r=$(dirname "$r"); done; l=love; [ -x "$r/out/love" ] && l="$r/out/love"; ("$l" bee --state busy --pid $PPID --hud </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &); exit 0
